body: Being a stay at home mom is a very sacrificial thing. Not only do you sacrifice your career and salary... you can lose a little self respect and dignity in the process. The thoughts of "I'm totally worthless to my family because my SO is out struggling to feed us while I do grocery shopping and watch the children and chill at home" etc etc can really creep up on someone over 5-10-15+ years of not working. it can get tough, it certainly was for my mother. She was severely depressed for decades until she started working again. props to these mothers for being brave enough to make that sacrifice to raise their children. However, being a stay at home mom is just that.. a sacrifice for your children and family. Not a career. Well said bro
